title: Ambrosial Uruguayan Milk Crumble
description: A festive, crumbly Uruguayan dessert that blends whole milk, sweet condensed milk, and buttery biscuits into a caramelized crumble, served from a traditional kazan cauldron.
instructions: Preheat the kazan cauldron over medium heat and melt the butter until foamy.
Add sugar, sweetened condensed milk, whole milk, vanilla, cinnamon, and salt; stir until the sugar is dissolved.
Bring the mixture to a gentle simmer, letting it thicken for 5 minutes while stirring occasionally.
Remove the cauldron from heat and fold in the crushed biscuits, ensuring an even coverage.
Return the mixture to the cauldron and reduce heat to low, cooking for 10 minutes until bubbly.
Increase heat to medium-high and stir vigorously for 2 minutes, creating a caramelized crumb top.
Transfer the mixture to a serving dish, pressing lightly to form a compact layer.
Let it cool for 15 minutes, then sprinkle toasted coconut flakes and lime zest before serving.
